thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] high 5xx rate on /v1/generate - hitting 12% errors in us-west-2 for last 2m. paging oncall group.
Maya: acked. I’m on it, pulling logs now.
Maya: looks like a surge of KVCACHE misses + a couple of models with OOM spikes, seeing repeated `redis ECONNRESET` in the edge logs.
Liam: I’m seeing worker pods in gw-service restarting with OOMKill around the same window. attaching snippet: ```
OOMKilled process: python3 -m inference.runner
RSS > limit
```
Nora: tagging support: any customer reports yet?
Sophia: support: one customer (acme-corp) filed a noisy error but not a P1 yet. they reported timeouts in user-facing chat.
Maya: mitigation: flip routing to fallback-model-128 for requests to reduce memory pressure, will limit to <10% rollout. Executing now.
oncall-bot: executed route override: /v1/generate -> fallback-model-128 (10% rollouts) by Maya at 11:02 UTC.
Liam: scaling note: autoscaler spiked but we throttled scale-up due to quota. I’m manually increasing pool for gw-service by +2 instances.
Kevin: created a temporary KV-cache bypass on a misbehaving shard to reduce thundering. doc snippet: `kvcache.bypass(shard=12)`
Maya: after route override + extra instances, error rate dropped to ~2.1% in 4m. continuing observation.
Nora: customer impact: acme-corp experienced degraded latency and some 5xx for ~6 minutes; ops ticket linked: OPS-4523.
Sophia: I opened a support incident with acme-corp, letting them know we’re mitigating and will follow up with a root cause/update postmortem.
Liam: mitigation complete, rolling back rollout to normal traffic. keeping a watch for 10m.
Maya: root cause hypothesis: a recent model quantization change plus a hot shard of KV-cache causing cache storms and memory amplification on some worker types. collecting eval traces + model versions.
incident-bot: created incident record INC-2024-17185, severity: sev2, sla: 1h.
Kevin: for postmortem: I captured the container OOM logs and kube events, pushed to /shared/incidents/1718504327/logs.tar.gz.
Maya: scheduling postmortem meeting: proposing tomorrow 16:00 UTC. who can own writeup?
Liam: I can start draft of timeline and attach logs.
Nora: I’ll take customer impact section and comms timeline.
Sophia: I’ll coordinate support follow-ups and paste the customer-facing note after review.
Kevin: I’ll own remediation tasks (KV-cache backpressure, model gating).
Maya: action items: 1) revert recent quantization patch on model-x (owner: Liam, eta: 48h). 2) add KV-cache shard-level backpressure and alert (owner: Kevin, eta: 72h). 3) autoscaler quota guard - ensure quick temporary scale-up path (owner: Maya, eta: 24h). 4) create canary test that exercises KVCACHE miss storms (owner: Nora, eta: 5 days).
Maya: I added these to INC-2024-17185 actions.
Liam: quick snippet to reproduce local-heavy-kv-miss: ```bash
# run contention sim
python tools/kv_stress.py --shard 12 --qps 200
```
Sophia: scheduling brown bag: propose a 45min session next week to share learnings and prevention patterns (title: "Preventing KVCACHE storms & model gating best practices"). available Wed/Thu morning PT?
Nora: Wed 09:30 PT works for me.
Kevin: Thu blocked, prefer Wed.
Maya: Wed 09:30 PT works. Liam?
Liam: Wed OK. put me down for a 15min demo of the canary test.
incident-bot: reminder set for postmortem doc due in 48h; ping owners: Liam, Kevin, Maya, Nora.
Maya: quick follow-up, we should also add a production alert for concurrent mem spikes across workers (threshold: >4 workers OOM within 2m). Kevin can you add?
Kevin: will add alert rule and test in staging today.
Sophia: once PM doc is ready, I’ll help craft the external customer note and send it to acme-corp by EOD following review.
Maya: thanks all — handoff to next oncall in 20m. leaving the incident channel open for postmortem work. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: handoff recorded: Maya -> Liam at 11:22 UTC.
Liam: taking handoff. I’ll finish timeline and trigger the postmortem meeting invite.
Nora: adding retrospective agenda: what went well, what didn’t, detection & escalation gaps, prevention patterns.
Maya: tagging follow-up owners, please update INC-2024-17185 with progress so we can close loop in retrospective.
Sophia: noted — I’ll include the customer impact & resolution summary in the support ticket.
Kevin: pushing PR for kv backpressure alert: https://git.internal/r/kv-alerts/pull/112
Liam: draft timeline pushed to the incident doc, starting with earliest log at 10:56 UTC.
Maya: last note — consider adding canary coverage for recent quantization deploys. big win if we can prevent this from reaching prod next time.
Nora: agreed. see you at the brown bag.
Sophia: thanks everyone, nice quick mitigation.
Maya: :heart:
